meta.title: A voided stage is marked void and stays out of every read
gaps: The available setup creates only two stages, so publishing two of three stages cannot be represented.
The available operations do not provide an assertion for a stage being absent from every API read; only the technical round's void status and the event/pricing round read-backs are checked.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with a technical (RFP) round and a pricing (RFQ) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer publishes the event with 1 draft trade request uuids.
As the buyer, read the technical round and check that “status” equals void.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that “status” equals active.
As the buyer, read the event and check that “status” equals active.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “status” equals void; “status” equals active; “status” equals active.
